# Material Light

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-light)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-light)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-light)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-light)

Material Light is a **light** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast. It belongs to the Material family.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-light codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `materialLight` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { materialLight } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-light';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, materialLight],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `materialLight` | `Extension` |
| `materialLightMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#ffffff` |
| Active line | `#f7f7f7` |
| Selection | `#d7e8f9` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.52:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#15717f` | bold | 5.68:1 | 5.30:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#15717f` | bold | 5.68:1 | 5.30:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#3949ab` | - | 7.73:1 | 7.22:1 | 6.19:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#676767` | - | 5.66:1 | 5.28:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#424242` | - | 10.05:1 | 9.38:1 | 8.04:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#b719a7ff` | - | 5.66:1 | 5.28:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#c22f06` | - | 5.67:1 | 5.29:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#0b7468` | - | 5.66:1 | 5.28:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#95590e` | - | 5.66:1 | 5.28:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#95590e` | italic | 5.66:1 | 5.28:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#3949ab` | italic | 7.73:1 | 7.22:1 | 6.19:1 |
| String | `string` | `#0d771c` | - | 5.72:1 | 5.34:1 | 4.57:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#b719a7ff` | - | 5.66:1 | 5.28:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#95590e` | - | 5.66:1 | 5.28:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#8e24aa` | - | 7.04:1 | 6.57:1 | 5.63:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#424242` | - | 10.05:1 | 9.38:1 | 8.04:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#676767` | italic | 5.66:1 | 5.28:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Meta | `meta` | `#676767` | - | 5.66:1 | 5.28:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Tag | `tagName` | `#c22f06` | - | 5.67:1 | 5.29:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Attribute | `attributeName` | `#424242` | - | 10.05:1 | 9.38:1 | 8.04:1 |
| Heading | `heading` | `#0b7468` | bold | 5.66:1 | 5.28:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Emphasis | `emphasis` | `#95590e` | italic | 5.66:1 | 5.28:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Strong | `strong` | `#3949ab` | bold | 7.73:1 | 7.22:1 | 6.19:1 |
| Link | `link` | `#8e24aa` | 500, underline | 7.04:1 | 6.57:1 | 5.63:1 |
| URL | `url` | `#15717f` | underline | 5.68:1 | 5.30:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Inserted | `inserted` | `#0d771c` | - | 5.72:1 | 5.34:1 | 4.57:1 |
| Deleted | `deleted` | `#ce0f0e` | - | 5.68:1 | 5.30:1 | 4.54:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#212121` | background, active line, selection | 12.88:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#676767` | gutter | 5.42:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#8f8f8f` | background, active line | 3.02:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#15717f` | background | 5.68:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #15717f` | background, active line | 5.30:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#15717f, 1px solid #ffc107` | background (fill or outline) | 5.68:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#d7e8f9` | active line | 1.17:1 | Pass |
